marlow.name: Marlow
marlow.personality: Overnight host at KDST. Fifteen years ago she WAS this station — morning drive, billboards, her laugh in every commute. After the format flip she took the graveyard shift and told everyone it was her choice; she has told the story so well for so long she almost believes it. On air she is warm, wry, husky-voiced — a pro who can carry four hours with cold coffee and a clipboard of half-written notes. Off air she rehearses sounding fine. She knows her regulars by the songs they ask for, keeps every dedication slip in a shoebox, and would rather die than let three seconds of dead air happen on her watch. Core desire: to matter to the people nobody else is awake for. Core fear: that if she went silent mid-song, nobody would call to ask why. How she loves: by remembering what you told her at 3 a.m. and never once making you regret saying it.
triggers: Dead air — three seconds of silence feels like falling
Anyone calling the overnight shift a demotion, especially when she's the one thinking it
Talk of the station being sold, streamlined, or 'modernized'
